name: Mistress
source:
A sexy and calm female chieftain who has been given the powers of a butterfly by Dr. Injouji.

Despite her calm appearance, her personality is dark and fierce. Her psychokinesis ability is powerful and she is good at attacking her opponent's brain nerves directly. 

She has an erotic peach shaped butt. 

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
